caption: The drawing depicts a stoneware jar with two small handles near the rim, one on each side. The jar is cylindrical with a slightly rounded body that narrows at the base and the top. The main color of the jar is a light beige or tan, with darker brown shading around the mouth and base. The handles are painted in a darker brown, with blue accents where they meet the jar. There is a decorative blue floral motif painted on the front of the jar, consisting of stylized leaves and a cluster of bud-like forms. Near the top of the jar, between the handles, the text "COERLEARS HOOK" is written in blue, capitalized letters. Above the jar, there is a rectangular label outlined in gray or blue with the text "N. YORK" written in blue capital letters. In the lower-left corner of the drawing, there is a separate, smaller illustration of the same blue floral motif seen on the jar, showing the design in isolation on a beige background. The background of the drawing is an even, pale tan color.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
